refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: io.systemd.PCRExtend is a Varlink interface implemented by systemd1-related components. It can be introspected and called with varlinkctl1.

refsect1.title: Interface Definition
refsect1.para: The following interface definition is exposed:
refsect1.programlisting:
# TPM PCR Extension APIs interface io.systemd.PCRExtend
# Event type to store in event log type EventType( phase, filesystem, volume_key, machine_id, product_id, keyslot, nvpcr_init, nvpcr_separator, dm_verity, imds_userdata )
# Measure some text or binary data into a PCR method Extend( # PCR number to extend, in range of 0…23. Either this or 'nvpcr' must be specified, not both, not neither. pcr: ?int, # NvPCR to extend, identified by a string. Either this or 'pcr' must be specified, not both, not neither. nvpcr: ?string, # Text string to measure. (Specify either this, or the 'data' field below, not both) text: ?string, # Binary data to measure, encoded in Base64. (Specify either this, or the 'text' field above, not both) data: ?string, # HMAC key, encoded in Base64. When set, the HMAC of the measured data keyed by this secret is extended rather than a plain hash. secret: ?string, # Event type to include in the (userspace) event log). This is optional, and mostly for debugging. eventType: ?EventType ) -> ()
error NoSuchNvPCR()
# Space for NV indexes/NvPCRs exhausted, cannot measure. error NvPCRSpaceExhausted()

refsect1.title: Examples
refsect1.para: varlinkctl introspect SERVICE io.systemd.PCRExtend shows the interface definition as served by SERVICE, and varlinkctl call SERVICE io.systemd.PCRExtend.Extend '{}' invokes its Extend method.
